messages:
miguel: heads up — saw a spike of 502s from the new prompt routing endpoint in us-west-2 after the rollout. dashboard: https://rdw.infra/d/routers/latency - 12% of traffic hitting ff_prompt_router_v3 is erroring right now :rotating_light:
incidents-bot: Pager triggered (sev2) for service=prompt-router, condition=5xx_rate>5% over 1m. Incident created: INC-20260315-2794
sara (oncall): picking this up. miguel can you paste the recent logs for the failed requests? are we seeing model timeouts or gateway errors?
miguel: logs show a mix — many 502s with backend proto errors, some soft OOM traces in the new endpoint pods. snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T12:03:41Z] prompt-router-v3 pod-7f8c: 502 backend read error: kvcache miss + grpc: conn reset by peer
[2026-03-15T12:03:42Z] prompt-router-v3 pod-7f8c: runtime: allocation failed: out of memory
```
kevin: oncall handoff? i'm available to join. initial hypothesis: the experimental router variant (v3) has an aggressive batching/kv cache config that blows GPU memory under certain prefix distributions.
sara (oncall): thanks. miguel can you gate the canary (slice) and redirect traffic back to router-v2 while we triage? I want rollback pref over slow mitigation.
miguel: initiating FF kill for ff_prompt_router_v3 now. using flag service API:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_AUTH" https://flags.redwood.internal/api/toggle \
  -d '{"flag":"ff_prompt_router_v3","state":"off","actor":"miguel","reason":"emergency kill - 502 spike"}'
```
ops-bot: Feature flag ff_prompt_router_v3 set to OFF by miguel. Immediate rollout to 0% canary. Routing re-evaluation in progress.
incidents-bot: Update: traffic shift detected. us-west-2 0.0% -> v3 within 30s. error-rate dropping.
anita: good call. product impact? which customers hit this?
jules: support ticket queue — 3 reports in last 10m from two enterprise customers in us-west about poor responses. flagged customers: acme-inc, medly-health. we'll send an urgent note once you confirm rollback complete.
kevin: confirming pods for v3 are being drained and K8s rollout reverted for the service. command used:
```
kubectl -n infra scale deployment prompt-router-v3 --replicas=0
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment prompt-router-v2
```
miguel: quick perf numbers after kill: 5xx rate from 6.2% -> 0.8% in us-west2, p95 latency back to 180ms from 420ms.
sara (oncall): great. i'm escalating to sev2 and adding eng-runtime and product. items next: postmortem owner, timeline, and safe rollout plan for v3 (memory tuning + smaller canary). kevin want to own the rollback verification and root cause?
kevin: will do. I'll capture heap profiles and KV cache metrics (kv_hit_ratio, kv_evictions). beginning tracer capture for affected traces.
anita: i'll draft the customer message for acme-inc/medly and loop in account managers. key point: we rolled back an experimental router due to increased errors; mitigation complete; follow-up with timeline and root cause next 24h.
jules: queued outbound messages, waiting for final confirmation to send.
ops-bot: Incident INC-20260315-2794 status: mitigation=in-progress -> resolved-by-rollback. assigned: kevin (eng-sre) owner for RCA.
sara (oncall): marking incident as "mitigated". switch to postmortem channel for RCA. anyone see leftover anomalies?
miguel: one small region (eu-central) had a tiny bump but unrelated — looks like canary assignment overlap; I'll check routing policy tags to avoid cross-region leakage.
kevin: collecting artifacts: logs, heapdump links, k8s events, and the ff toggle timeline. will post in the postmortem.
anita: thanks team. action items: (1) RFC for canary isolation and mem caps (owner: kevin) (2) revamp FF rollouts to include mem/safety checks (owner: eng-runtime) (3) customer comms sent (owner: anita/jules).
sara (oncall): closing pager, leaving ticket open until RCA. good job, everyone :thumbsup:
